proof:
by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hji⟩ := hs.exists_ne i
  have hxj : ∀ k ∈ s, x k = z := fun k hk => by
    have h := hz k hk
    rw [hc k hk, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one] at h
    exact h
  have hyi : y i = z := by
    have hsub : x '' ((↑s : Set ι) \ {i}) ⊆ {z} := by
      rintro w ⟨k, ⟨hks, hki⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.2 (hxj k (Finset.mem_coe.1 hks))
    have h2 := convexHull_mono hsub (hy i hi)
    rwa [convexHull_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h2
  have hne : (s \ {i}).Nonempty := ⟨j, Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hj, by simpa using hji⟩⟩
  have hsum : ∑ k ∈ s \ {i}, x k = (s \ {i}).card • z :=
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => hxj k (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hk).1).trans (Finset.sum_const z)
  rw [hyi, hsum, nsmul_eq_smul_cast 𝕜, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hne.card_pos.ne'), one_smul]
